The one decision · sheet corner radius
16px · FOUNDER-LOCKED 10-Jul-2026 · FINAL, maintained after the ladder exploration
One radius across the whole system, our locked card is 16px. Cleaner, more unified.
22px · explored under the ladder, reverted same day
Softer, sheets feel a touch more distinct from cards (Airbnb ~20–24px).
ADOPT into the sheet token
  • Top-only rounded corners + dark scrim (~45%)
  • Header = title left + X close top-right (Airbnb convention, consistent)
  • Fitted sheets get a small top-centre grabber (grey #787882); full sheets use the X
  • Dock uses our banked button, model per sheet type — Extend = one full-width, On-hold = two (primary + text-secondary), Contact = action-rows, no dock
  • Dismiss by X, scrim-tap, or swipe
SKIP (stays ours)
  • Airbnb black / UC purple / Fresha on the dock buttons — we use #2B2FBE + our banked radius
  • X-left header variants — X stays top-right
  • Their rounded-rect button radii — our pill
Honest flags: the fitted-sheet GRABBER (Airbnb #133) wasn’t cleanly captured, my crop hit the content, so its exact size/colour is inferred from iOS convention, re-pull #133 top before banking if you want it exact. Our three docks are a composition of the three referenced models (parts pinned, assembly ours), not one frame.
DECIDED (founder, 10-Jul-2026, FINAL after three states): sheet corner radius = 16px, matching the card. Arc: 16 locked (two-tier) → 22 explored (reference ladder, Airbnb ~20-24) → 16 maintained.
